result.title: Chain Dimension Scaling: Communication-Efficient Loop-Style Scaling for Industrial Short-Video Ranking
result.summary: Industrial recommendation rankers keep scaling in width and depth to billions of parameters, but this increasingly incurs costs in parameter growth, distributed communication overhead, and training inefficiency. We introduce \underline{C}hain \underline{D}imension \underline{S}caling (CDS), a scaling strategy orthogonal to width and depth. CDS repeatedly applies a single feature-interaction block with parameters shared across iterations, so the number of iterations (the chain length) becomes a new scaling dimension that adds no parameters. A lightweight intra-chain residual connection stabilizes optimization and improves quality. CDS enables two regimes. In the \emph{compression regime}, shallow blocks with a longer chain match deeper baselines with fewer parameters and faster training; in the \emph{quality-scaling regime}, increasing chain length under a fixed parameter budget yields consistent offline and online gains, suggesting the chain dimension adds modeling capacity beyond parameter reuse. We evaluate CDS in a large-scale multi-task short-video ranking system in production. In the compression regime, CDS stays within $0.03\%$ of baseline offline quality while reducing trainable parameters by 26.6\% and improving training throughput by 6.4\%, with neutral-to-positive online participation. In the quality-scaling regime, quality improves monotonically with chain length. Wall-clock analysis shows the efficiency gain comes mainly not from reduced FLOPs but from lower cross-device synchronization overhead and reduced optimizer update cost. These results position parameter-shared iterative computation as a practical, communication-efficient scaling axis for industrial ranking systems.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 CDS：在工业短视频排序系统中把同一个特征交互块重复迭代、参数跨迭代共享，使「链长」（迭代次数）成为不增加参数的新扩展维度，并用链内残差连接稳定优化；在生产系统上比较压缩与质量扩展两种 regime 的离线在线效果、训练吞吐与延迟构成。
AI.relevance_reason: 参数共享的循环迭代、以迭代次数作为额外建模容量、以及残差稳定深层循环的做法，可能为 LVR 中 loop 式 latent 状态更新的深度/长度扩展与训练稳定性提供可核查线索，但其任务与视觉或多模态推理无直接关系，深度收益是否源于参数复用之外也需另行核实。
